import os,re,itertools
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0])
    fr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(I[r]))==1]; fc=[c for c in range(W) if len({I[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    line = I[fr[0]][0] if fr else I[fc[0]][0]
    pts=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c,v in enumerate(I[r]):
            if v!=line: pts[v].append((r,c))
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    seen=set()
    for v,lst in pts.items():
        L=sorted(lst)
        # pairs of nearest neighbors along a shared row/col; also each cell connects to next marker along its row/col? use: for each consecutive pair in sorted order sharing row or col
        for a,b in zip(L,L[1:]) if False else None: pass
        # simpler: consecutive markers in the same color
        i=0
        while i<len(L):
            j=i+1
            while j<len(L) and L[j][0]==L[i][0]: j+=1
            # segment between
            for t in range(min(L[i][1],L[j-1][1])+1,max(L[i][1],L[j-1][1])):
                q=(L[i][0],t)
                if I[q[0]][q[1]]!=line: O[q[0]][q[1]]=v
            i=j
    return O
for i in (1,2,3):
    res=solve(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); O=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    bad=[(r,c,O[r][c],res[r][c]) for r in range(len(O)) for c in range(len(O[0])) if O[r][c]!=res[r][c]]
    print(i,'ndiff',len(bad),bad[:8])
